candidate.underlying_graph: Exactly Huang's G_{H,I} construction with H=C7 and an all-positive 3-CNF I_k. No graph edge is added by Janus.
clauses: one clause for every 3-subset of optional variables
for optional v_i, exactly k^2+i copies of marker clause (x1,x3,v_i)
candidate.size: Theta(k^3) graph vertices because the number of clause C7 gadgets is Theta(k^3).

published_source.paper: Shenwei Huang, Improved Complexity Results on k-Coloring P_t-Free Graphs, European Journal of Combinatorics 51 (2016) 336-346
claims_used: The construction G_{H,I} uses variable K2 gadgets, D vertices, clause copies H_j, U complete to all X/D, and C vertices adjacent to d_i and the corresponding literal vertex.
If H is P_t-free for t>=6 then G_{H,I} is P_t-free.
For 4-coloring the paper uses H=C7, hence every graph in this candidate family is P7-free.
published_source.hardness_firewall: The NP-completeness theorem is not used to infer hardness or absence of a polynomial carrier. Only the construction and P7-freeness theorem are imported.

source_seed.distinguished_clause_roles: c*=h1_0 corresponds to x2; u*=h1_1 and h1_6 are its two C7 neighbors.
proof: The seed is proper and connected: h1_0 is adjacent to x2,h1_1,h1_6; x2 is adjacent to both U-type seed vertices; h1_1 and h1_6 are nonadjacent and may share color 3.
Any outside vertex complete to h1_0 and x2 would have to be one of the two C7 neighbors h1_1,h1_6, both already in S. Hence no outside vertex is complete to S.
No graph modification occurs, so Huang P7-freeness applies verbatim.
